ruling.recommended_action: Process a $3.12 voucher refund to the rider for the unexempted detour mileage; log the RD-1 violation on the driver's record (no account flag — driver has 0 upheld route disputes in 90d).

segment_findings.reason: RD-4 not met — no traffic incident on the optimal route [F12]; band-3 records only [F10][F11] which are neither band 1/2 nor sufficient alone (RD-4(b)). RD-3/RD-5 not met — the rider named no location and never replied to the driver's 18:28 question [F7]; the driver's post-trip 'no objection' statement [F9] is a claim, not rider consent (gap G11). The extra 2.21 km on this segment is therefore unexempted.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's written statement that the rider raised no objection is an account of verbal/implicit consent; the record shows no rider message, and a driver's consent claim cannot substitute for a rider-sent consent message before the detour began (RD-5, gap G11).
Band 3 (20–29 km/h) on New Bridge Road is neither band 1 nor 2 and, on its own, cannot exempt a segment under RD-4(b).
Band 3 (20–29 km/h) on Sentosa Gateway likewise cannot exempt the segment under RD-4(b).
